checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The includesText names arrangements conference, notices, permits, shelter of remains, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No additional mandatory fee for staff, facilities or overhead appears; other charges are listed as separate selectable items.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range $1,695 to $1,945 is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with a fiberboard container or unfinished wood box, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions cremation, but no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered service lacks its own line.
The list contains only required single-price items and separately priced goods and services, with no optional combination package.
No statement asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No claim about delaying decomposition long-term or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and required disclosures appear in full clear text.
